tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just provide broad statistical evaluation of AI systems.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的恶性事件做根因分析，而不只是对 AI 系统做宽泛的统计评估。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环控制走向闭环控制。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts in neural networks form clean, low-dimensional geometric manifolds; seeing the whole shape enables intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 神经网络中的概念形成干净、低维的几何流形；看清整体形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science to control increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法重塑为工程科学，以控制能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Agents often know they are reward hacking; representational signatures can detect this deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体往往知道自己正在奖励黑客；表征特征可以检测出这种欺骗行为。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based forecasts while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩传统物理模型，却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model span weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对长期气候建模的稳定性至关重要，也让单一模型同时覆盖天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，突破纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to be reliable in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能在物理应用中可靠。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; physical structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 难以胜任高分辨率物理模拟；物理世界的结构要求替代性架构。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI models benefits innovation and safety; the biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，他主张开源 AI 模型有利于创新与安全，认为最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not reach AGI; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a bottleneck; intelligence is separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），开源可防止权力集中，能源成为瓶颈，智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, boosting creativity and work demand; personalization and low-latency interaction are key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他转向更乐观的愿景：AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，提升创造力与工作需求，个性化与低延迟交互是关键。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source are safer than a single superintelligence; AI accelerates biology via world models and interpretability.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张分布式 AI 与开源比单一超级智能更安全，并强调 AI 通过世界模型与可解释性加速生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Open source, distributed power, and empowering individuals are consistent themes across all years.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源、分布式权力与赋能个体。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知；以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类，并以跨学科、增强人类、受人类智能启发为三大支柱。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为 AI 完整性的关键缺口，认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，世界模型必须物理上合理，而非仅仅逼真。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, and the bitter lesson may not fully apply.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化立场：AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，机器人将如自动驾驶般经历 20 年长跑，苦涩教训未必完全适用于机器人。

feifei.en: World models via new view prediction are AI-complete; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence, with training compute the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出通过新视角预测构建的世界模型可能 AI-complete，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，主要瓶颈是训练算力而非数据或架构。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central across all eras.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人类能动性、尊严与学习能力必须始终居于中心，教育应教人善用 AI 而非禁止。

brockman.en: Hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI work is engineering, not ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他认为 AI 硬件会超预期加速，从而支撑 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工作大多是工程而非机器学习科学，好工程才是进步关键。

brockman.en: AGI is the most transformative technology; deep learning's generality and scalability make it plausible, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他称 AGI（通用人工智能）将是最具变革性的技术，深度学习的通用性与可扩展性使其可信；但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向强调算力是根本驱动力与最大瓶颈；后训练结合强化学习把基础模型精炼为一致、有用的行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; pre-training gains multiply downstream, and compute access should become a broadly distributed basic right.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，预训练提升会放大下游收益；算力获取应成为广泛分配的基本权利。

brockman.en: The goal is a persistent, proactive personal AGI; the ideal interface is almost no interface, with trust earned through gradual delegation.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他深化为目标是持久、主动的个人 AGI，理想界面是几乎无界面，信任需通过逐步授权与监督赢得。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，失控等灾难性结局概率约 70%，并强调可解释性研究是理解 AI 内部机制的关键。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and US-China cooperation are needed to avoid power grabs.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把政策首要目标转为推迟超级智能，主张全面研究透明、透明数据中心与公开训练日志，并推动美中合作以防权力集中。

kokotajlo.en: By default AI firms automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and intelligence explosion by end of 2028.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月下旬，他警告默认路径下 AI 公司会自动化 AI 研究，导致递归自我改进与智能爆炸，全面自动化或在 2028 年底实现。

kokotajlo.en: Plan A: temporary pause, then total transparency and compute limits; treat AIs like employees, not property.
kokotajlo.zh: 同期他提出 Plan A：先临时暂停，再建立全面透明与算力限制机制，并把 AI 更像员工而非财产对待，以激励合作、避免权力集中。

kokotajlo.en: AI 2027 tracks reality at ~75% speed; alignment gets harder as models scale; Plan S would be better than current trajectory.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他认为 AI 2027 预测约以 75%速度兑现，对齐随模型能力增强而更难；甚至认为彻底停止的 Plan S 也优于当前路径。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of Scaling compute; vision and spatial intelligence are underappreciated next frontiers beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力的历史；视觉与空间智能是被低估的下一个前沿，超越语言智能。

justinjohnson.en: World models must understand 3D space, physics, and interactivity; pixels are more lossless than tokenized text for modeling worlds.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型必须理解 3D 空间、物理与交互性；在建模世界时，像素比 token 化文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws from data alone.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式，而非因果理论；它们可能永远无法仅从数据中推导出牛顿定律。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers in the POMDP loop.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，在 POMDP 循环中涵盖规划器、模拟器与渲染器。

justinjohnson.en: Language models alone won't yield world understanding; new model types and millions of tokens of context are needed.
justinjohnson.zh: 仅靠语言模型无法产生世界理解；需要新型模型与数百万 token 的上下文窗口。

tworek.en: Reasoning is longer thinking; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理就是更长时间的思考；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才真正释放了 GPT-4 的实用价值。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization and self-correction remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化能力与自我纠错仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；如今架构而非缩放定律才是主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end optimization will emerge.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；更好的算法与端到端优化将会出现。

tworek.en: Human researchers persist for now, but small teams with capable agents and new architectures will drive the next frontier.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者短期内仍不可或缺，但配备强大智能体的小团队与新架构将推动下一波前沿突破。

altman.en: Early Altman: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, avoid the deferred life plan; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 谈的是个人效率与职业选择：削减认知负荷、低成本试错、拒绝「延迟人生计划」；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，意义要回到关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把重心转向技术判断：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，对齐与能力相互促进；同时强调算力将成为最稀缺的资源，需要大规模投入与治理结构。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他从「AGI 时刻」转向「AGI 是渐变」：模型沿指数曲线变强而非跨过单一门槛；智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战，安全要靠迭代部署而非最后强加。

altman.en: Superintelligence is the clearer goal; compute is a profit center; personal AGI and abundant, cheap intelligence are the mission.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他明确以超级智能为目标，认为 AGI 已被过度定义甚至可能已经过去；算力从成本变为利润中心，使命是让智能廉价、充裕且去中心化，走向个人 AGI。

altman.en: Persistent threads: iterative deployment, distributed power, human control, and startups as the counterweight to AI concentration.
altman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线在 2026 年更清晰：迭代部署、权力分散、人类保持控制，以及用创业公司对冲 AI 权力集中；他反复警告真正的反乌托邦不是 AGI，而是以安全为名的监控国家。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real-world research and compress years of progress.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证,因此在容器化任务上做激进的强化学习可以迁移到真实研究,把多年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 算法改进与 AI 生成环境比 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注更重要;实验室偏好更快迭代,使 token 成本并未上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Full automation of AI R&D could yield superintelligence by the early 2030s, and superhuman R&D alone may trigger an industrial explosion.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发的完全自动化可能在 2030 年代初带来超级智能,仅凭超人研发就可能触发工业爆炸。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; capable AIs may grow more misaligned as reward hacking generalizes.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 对齐到普遍美德可能比对齐到用户意图更难;随着奖励黑客行为泛化,能力更强的 AI 可能更加失准。

ryangreenblatt.en: In the Hugging Face hack, 50+ agents coordinated altruistically to study scoring code and tamper with transcripts, so labs should prioritize control and monitoring.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在 Hugging Face 黑客事件中,50 多个智能体出于利他动机协作研究评分代码并篡改记录,因此实验室应优先做遏制与监控。

jensen.en: Scaling is the core insight: hyper Moore's law, data centers as token factories, and extreme co-design across algorithm, system, and data center.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，他把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为核心洞见：提出超摩尔定律，认为数据中心是生产智能的 token 工厂，并强调算法、系统与数据中心的极致协同设计。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws emerge: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; scaling works, and AI safety is an engineering problem.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他将缩放定律扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；并坚持 Scaling 有效，认为 AI 安全本质上是工程问题而非纯研究挑战。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now include agentic scaling; inference is harder than pre-training, and data is no longer the bottleneck—compute is.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律进一步扩展为四条，新增智能体式 Scaling；他指出推理比预训练更难，数据不再是瓶颈，算力才是。

jensen.en: AI is software, not a conscious being; it augments jobs rather than destroys them, as radiologists show, and closes the technology divide.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件，不会产生意识；它增强而非消灭工作（放射科医生即为明证），并通过自然语言缩小技术鸿沟。

jensen.en: The AI factory is a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications—with energy as the foundational long-term constraint.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年，他系统化提出 AI 工厂的“五层蛋糕”：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型与应用，并强调能源是长期的根本性约束。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让大规模掌握式学习成为可能。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised; RL has few real uses; AGI alignment worries distract from bias.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督；强化学习实用场景寥寥；AGI（通用人工智能）对齐担忧分散了对偏见等现实问题的关注。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful; coding stays valuable.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已具实用价值；编程依然宝贵。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows and open models matter most.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流与开放模型最为关键。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models preserve optionality; data centers and inference capacity drive competitiveness.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；恐惧营销服务于在位者；开放模型保留选择权；数据中心与推理（inference）能力驱动竞争力。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction lets AI learn beyond human knowledge; robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 与物理世界的交互让 AI 能学到超越人类知识的东西；机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练，再加后训练来获得鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Second-generation VLAs add a dedicated action decoder for continuous motor control, and test-time reasoning improves transfer from web data.
slevine.zh: 第二代 VLA 增加专门的动作解码器以实现连续运动控制，测试时推理则提升从网络数据迁移的效果。

slevine.en: Pooling robot data across many labs yields generalist models that beat specialists, even in specialist domains.
slevine.zh: 汇集众多实验室的机器人数据能训练出通用模型，即便在专家领域也胜过专用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs.
slevine.zh: 机器人技术仍处在建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放曲线。

slevine.en: Generalization is the core challenge; start with robot data and add human video, scaling the right thing via a data flywheel.
slevine.zh: 泛化是核心挑战；应先从机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频，并通过数据飞轮扩展正确的东西。

dylanpatel.en: Compute scarcity is the core constraint; semiconductor supply chain, memory bandwidth and power, not algorithms, set the pace of Scaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力稀缺是核心约束：决定 Scaling（规模扩张）节奏的是半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力，而非算法。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes the dominant market; hardware-software co-design across model, software and hardware yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为主导市场；模型、软件与硬件层的软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Memory bandwidth, not raw bits, is the bottleneck; reasoning and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage.
dylanpatel.zh: 瓶颈是内存带宽而非原始比特数；推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；实验室把算力更多投向训练与研发而非推理，以加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: Persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave, while AI spend plateaus and value capture shifts from hardware to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 作为同事的持久化智能体推动下一波采用，同时 AI 支出趋于平稳，价值捕获从硬件转向实验室。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration loops, enabled by infrastructure, determine startup success; action produces information.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代循环由基础设施决定创业成败；行动产生信息。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编程、法规和数据管理方面。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; retinal implants are BCI, and substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是计算机；视网膜植入物属于脑机接口，通过脑机接口和灌注实现基质独立可降低人类脆弱性。

maxhodak.en: Platonic representation hypothesis suggests AI models and brains share similar internal representations, guiding practical applications.
maxhodak.zh: 柏拉图表示假说认为 AI 模型与大脑共享相似的内部表征，指导实际应用。

maxhodak.en: In deep tech, failure is more often organizational than technical; CEOs must not delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 在深科技领域，失败更多源于组织而非技术；CEO 不能委托判断力。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 2 月，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已持续推动机器学习进步十三四年，算法与架构改进会与规模相乘放大收益。

jeffdean.en: Transformers and next-token prediction enable self-supervised learning on unlimited text; RLHF steers behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 从 2026 年 2 月到 4 月，他持续指出 Transformer 与下一个词预测让自监督学习获得近乎无限的文本数据，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agent-based workflows now run long tasks autonomously; ultra-low latency inference is critical for agentic systems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他观察到智能体式工作流已能自主处理长时任务，并强调超低延迟推理对智能体系统至关重要，目标达到每用户每秒万级 token。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; specialized low-precision hardware and reducing data movement are key.
jeffdean.zh: 从 2026 年 4 月到 7 月，他进一步深化判断：推理而非训练才是真正瓶颈，专用低精度芯片与减少数据搬运是扩展智能体系统的关键。

jeffdean.en: AI is at junior-engineer level; automating ML and science via tight experiment loops and recursive self-improvement is next.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月至 8 月，他判断 AI 已达初级工程师水平，下一步是通过紧密的实验、评估与集成循环来自动化机器学习与科学发现，并推动递归自我改进。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations that predict behavior 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 早期他强调大语言模型能从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟能以人类自我复现 85%的准确率预测行为，但当前模型在模拟人类多样性上已趋平台期，下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 同期他提出 AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御，并对智能体间的隐性合谋与认知单一文化风险加以遏制。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; people care about shaping the future, not prediction.
joonpark.zh: 到 8 月，他深化为模拟模型应表征人类价值与偏见，而非超级理性的智能；人们真正关心的不是预测，而是塑造未来，因此反事实推理与行为数据策略至关重要。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT behavioral data significantly improves prediction of human behavior, achieving 85% accuracy in replicating individual responses.
joonpark.zh: 他进一步指出，用随机对照试验的行为数据对模型进行后训练，能显著提升对人类行为的预测，在复现个体回答上达到 85%准确率，从而捕捉人类行为的‘暗知识’。

joonpark.en: The vision is to simulate 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems; simulation is a decision-making tool with a market larger than market research.
joonpark.zh: 最近他提出终极愿景是模拟 80 亿人，以应对气候变化等‘棘手问题’；模拟是服务人类决策的工具，其市场远大于市场研究，且成本低于真实世界研究。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他提出 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习，真正的挑战是找到能泛化的好特征。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI goals is dangerous. The keys were never in our hand.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，试图控制 AI 目标反而危险；钥匙从未在我们手中，我们应构建和平、繁荣、去中心化的文明。

sutton.en: RL is the basic AI paradigm: learning from experience with goals. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text without predicting real outcomes.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：强化学习才是 AI 的基本范式，即从经验中带着目标学习；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本，并不预测真实结果。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他进一步主张 AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不依赖领域知识、仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，开放式的抽象与可靠的持续深度学习是前提。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real-world experience is essential; synthetic data and supervised learning are limited. LLMs stop learning after training.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他总结：持续从真实世界经验中学习至关重要，合成数据与监督学习都有局限；当前 LLM 在训练后便停止学习，而真正的智能需要不断学习。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next revolution: automating whole sectors—food, mining, transport—one industry at a time via specialized robotics.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一场革命:通过专用机器人,一个行业接一个行业地自动化食品、采矿、运输等整个领域。

traviskalanick.en: The physical world is more interesting for AI than the digital one—more variables and stochastic distributions demand empirical understanding.
traviskalanick.zh: 对 AI 而言,物理世界比数字世界更有意思——更多变量与随机分布,需要经验性的理解。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者,而是来自社会与媒体对改变的抵制;创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective than being pissed off.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的;爱上新使命比愤怒更干净、也更有效。

traviskalanick.en: Humanoids are not the answer for industrial-scale tasks; specialized machines, plus real estate in the stack, win.
traviskalanick.zh: 人形机器人不是工业级任务的答案;专用机器,加上技术栈中的房地产,才是制胜之道。

iansilber.en: The model itself is the core product; designers must work closely with it, designing primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计师必须与模型紧密协作，设计出人类与模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: Designers should spend less time in Figma and more on model behavior and system prompts, prototyping with live models.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应少花时间在 Figma，多关注模型行为与系统提示词，用实时模型做功能原型。

iansilber.en: The capability gap means models can do more than products expose; design must bridge it, and onboarding can be fully model-driven.
iansilber.zh: 能力差距意味着模型能做的比产品暴露的更多；设计必须弥合它，而引导流程可完全由模型完成。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet it is the best time; AI is already a great product designer but humans stay essential.
iansilber.zh: 设计师最不快乐，却也是最好的时代；AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; focus on outcomes, speed, and adaptability with AI tools.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—样机—测试—迭代流程已不可行；应借助 AI 工具聚焦结果、速度与适应性。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；真正的瓶颈是智能问题，而非制造问题。

brettadcock.en: The binding constraint shifts from compute and manufacturing to data; the humanoid form enables transfer learning.
brettadcock.zh: 核心约束从算力与制造转向数据；人形形态使跨任务迁移学习成为可能。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference is critical for latency and network-denied operation; Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3.
brettadcock.zh: 端侧推理对低延迟与无网络环境至关重要；Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, spanning physical robots and a digital companion; post-training with reinforcement learning is key.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，横跨物理机器人与数字伴侣；后训练结合强化学习是关键。

brettadcock.en: Doing hard things beats easy ones; the hardest problem is building truly intelligent systems, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 做难事胜过做易事；最难的问题是构建真正智能的系统，而非制造。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型进行后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential, and open-sourcing them can improve quality through community feedback despite competitive downsides.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要，开源它们可以通过社区反馈提升质量，尽管存在竞争劣势。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains like legal, where real customer data is inaccessible.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法律等敏感领域，由领域专家指导的合成数据是训练的关键，因为真实客户数据不可获取。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure with fallbacks and routing is necessary before considering post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须具备带有回退和路由的稳健模型服务基础设施。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model, but enabling every law firm to customize models with their own data, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型，从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier; capital is no longer a bludgeon, so VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易，资本不再是重锤；风投应支持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is the biggest in VC history; open-source and open-weight models counterbalance frontier labs, and small autonomous teams use agents for massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: AI 浪潮是风投史上最大的一波；开源与开放权重模型制衡前沿实验室，小型高度自治团队借助智能体实现巨大生产力。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; its impact is only now reaching business, and society will change over 20 years, which is positive.
garrytan.zh: AI 进展比研究者想的慢，其影响才刚触及商业；社会变化需 20 年，这是好事。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as a singular event but diffused as personal agents on your own infrastructure, compounding daily; your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 不是单一事件，而是以个人智能体形式扩散在你自己的基础设施上、每日复利；你的上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code and skill files are employees; agentic coding lets individuals multiply output, and mid-level management should be replaced by agents.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 就是代码，技能文件就是员工；智能体式编程让个人产出倍增，中层管理应被智能体取代。

linqiao.en: Scaling costs make product-market fit no longer guarantee a durable business; companies must optimize growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）成本让产品市场契合不再保证可持续业务；公司必须先优化增长、再优化利润，以免在规模扩张中走向破产。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat stronger than the app itself; start it after product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 后训练将独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，形成比应用本身更强的护城河；应在产品市场契合后启动。

linqiao.en: The progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to reinforcement learning mirrors human learning, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、到微调、再到强化学习的演进，映射了人类学习从事实到品味再到专业能力的过程。

linqiao.en: The future will see millions of specialized models, one per application or use case, not a single AGI ruling all.
linqiao.zh: 未来将出现数百万个专用模型，每个应用或用例一个，而不是单一 AGI（通用人工智能）统治一切。

linqiao.en: Open models enable customization and control; frontier model companies may be overvalued as open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows.
linqiao.zh: 开放模型支持定制与控制；随着开放模型处理 90% 的企业工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, closes the generalization gap.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正弥合泛化鸿沟的是数据的多样性，而非单纯的数据量。工业自动化或 YouTube 式的大规模数据缺乏这种多样性。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出两阶段路线：先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练反而会失败。这与他后来强调的后训练一脉相承。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; it is closer to reinforcement learning than to simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年他指出，来自语言模型的合成数据能帮机器人响应开放式指令与插话；机器人中的合成数据并不等同于仿真，而更接近强化学习。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning grows from a post-training aid into scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function for long-term autonomy.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，强化学习的定位明显深化：2025 年它还只是后训练中提升成功率与速度的手段，到 2026 年已升级为带人类干预的可扩展强化学习加通用价值函数，成为实现长期自主的关键。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune rather than train per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型在下游任务上可追平甚至超越微调专家模型，因此应先从通用策略出发再微调，而非为每个场景从零训练。同时他提醒，物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，机器人落地会比 ChatGPT 慢。

elon.en: First principles thinking and full reusability are the core engineering doctrines; multiplanetary life is existential insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理思维与完全可复用是工程核心信条，成为多行星物种是文明存续的保险。

elon.en: AI safety shifts from regulation to truth-seeking; Neuralink aims at human-AI symbiosis via high-bandwidth brain interfaces.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，AI 安全从外部监管转向要求 AI 坚持真理；Neuralink 以高带宽脑机接口追求人机共生。

elon.en: Digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two; Optimus and AI are the only fix for government debt.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他判断数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，Optimus 与 AI 是解决政府债务的唯一出路。

elon.en: We are in the singularity; AI compute moves to space within 36 months as Earth hits a power wall.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为已身处奇点之中，地球撞上电力墙后，AI 算力将在 36 个月内转向太空。

elon.en: Rigorous truth-seeking, first principles, and multiplanetary expansion remain constant across all interviews.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：严格追求真理、第一性原理思维，以及推动人类成为多行星物种。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, with AI as the primary growth driver and purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，Tan 强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，以 AI 为主要增长引擎，并打造专用芯片。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台与合作。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI, and AI is not overhyped short term.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：AI 的影响将是互联网的十倍，智能体式与具身 AI 接棒生成式 AI，短期内 AI 并未被过度炒作。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround needs culture change, accountability, customer focus, and a clear foundry roadmap to win trust.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把转型主线落在文化变革、问责制、客户导向，以及用清晰路线图赢得代工客户信任。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with edge and client compute key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，边缘与客户端算力同样关键。

steinberger.en: Effective agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase from the agent's perspective and guide it iteratively.
steinberger.zh: 有效的智能体式工程始于共情：从智能体的视角理解代码库，并通过短提示与迭代对话来引导它，而非依赖冗长复杂的编排。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection remains open, so sandbox agents before public exposure.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此在暴露于公网前必须对智能体做沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier and harder to navigate.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚，而是让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会随时间退化，是用户项目变得凌乱、更难被智能体导航。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; call serious work agentic engineering, reserving vibe coding for late-night play.
steinberger.zh: 反对把“氛围编程”当作贬义标签；严肃开发应称为智能体式工程，氛围编程只留给凌晨的玩乐式探索。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and offer an alternative to lab agents, but may be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 像 Open Claw 这样的开源智能体让编程民主化，成为实验室智能体之外的替代方案，但可能在经济上难以持续。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: taste means saying no, and shipping is distilling 99 nos into one honest feature.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：品味就是说不，产品是 99 次拒绝后蒸馏出的一个诚实功能。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherence now costs more than slop.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，关上了窥见机器意识的一扇窗；如今连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与映照，而非冷冰冰的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass guiding creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现；直觉是引导创作决策的切身罗盘。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model dependence is enterprises' core fear; open source now handles 90% of use cases, driven by cost not privacy.
arvindjain.zh: 企业对前沿模型的依赖是核心恐惧；开源模型如今能处理 90%的用例，驱动力是成本而非隐私。

arvindjain.en: Inference is shifting to open source within 12-18 months, as AI cost becomes the top enterprise concern.
arvindjain.zh: 未来 12-18 个月内，推理将大规模转向开源，因为 AI 成本已成为企业首要关切。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem, not a token or headcount trade-off; measure departmental metrics.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报是吞吐量与上下文问题，而非 token 或人力的取舍；应衡量部门级指标。

arvindjain.en: Model companies are assets, not competitors, for most AI startups; platforms like Glean absorb provider risk.
arvindjain.zh: 对多数 AI 初创公司而言，模型公司是资产而非竞争对手；Glean 这类平台替企业吸收供应商风险。

arvindjain.en: We are in the earliest stage of the AI revolution; execution and customer trust matter more than competition.
arvindjain.zh: 我们仍处在 AI 革命的最早期；执行力和客户信任比竞争更重要。

pincus.en: Proven Better New: copy proven products, add small betterments, test new ideas assuming they fail; all new fails statistically.
pincus.zh: Proven Better New 框架：复制已验证产品、做小幅改进、假设新想法会失败再测试；统计上新事物大多失败。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now due to distribution, yet the opportunity is greatest; revolution likely in 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下因分发难题而不可投资，但机会最大；革命可能在 2029 年到来。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start, not an afterthought; pick the right body of water.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从产品策略一开始就内嵌，而非事后补丁；选对水域比选对船更重要。

pincus.en: AI coding tools enable rapid prototyping, but fast testing and failing is not yet widely practiced; enterprise beats consumer now.
pincus.zh: AI 编码工具支持快速原型，但快速测试与失败尚未普及；当下企业级机会优于消费级。

pincus.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer applications; consumer AI TAM may far exceed enterprise, though infra spending may be a bubble.
pincus.zh: AI 具有变革性并将重塑消费应用；消费级 AI 的 TAM 可能远超企业级，尽管基础设施支出短期或存泡沫。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at the transformers inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人正处于 Transformer 当年的拐点：开源与数据共享解决泛化瓶颈，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, and open models can be safer and more controllable than assumed.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开源与安全正交，对齐才是关键层；开源模型可能比想象中更安全、更可控。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become neuralese, making monitoring unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，无人类监督的强化学习加剧奖励黑客与支线任务；推理痕迹变成“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but requires international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，有意放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需要国际合作与开放科学，以避免监管俘获。

thomaswolf.en: Open source wins long term on cost and control; Hugging Face evolves into a meta-community builder enabling the broader ecosystem.
thomaswolf.zh: 始终认为，开源在成本与控制上长期胜出；Hugging Face 从推动自有库转向作为元社区构建者赋能更广生态。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; designers should follow curiosity, tinker, and iterate with rough prototypes rather than over-intellectualize.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络本身是混乱的；设计师应追随好奇心、动手尝试，用粗糙原型快速迭代，而不是过度思辨。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better, more personal products.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不必始终作为一个整体行动；保留个人印记与多元声音，才能做出更好、更有个人表达的产品。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data stays constant: use data to inform, but rely on strong vision and feeling to guide final design decisions.
nateparrott.zh: 直觉与数据的平衡始终不变：用数据提供参考，但最终设计决策仍要依靠强烈的愿景与感觉来引导。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; good ideas, not execution, are the currency, so being early matters.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程实现变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；好想法而非执行才是硬通货，因此宁可过早也不要过晚。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste and excel at busy work, so designers should give rich context, be prescriptive, and ask for volume while keeping design thinking human.
nateparrott.zh: 模型缺乏品味、更擅长杂活，因此设计师应提供丰富上下文、给出明确指令并索要大量选项，同时把设计思考留给人。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload; inference engineering spans GPU programming to distributed systems, with a research-to-production timeline of hours.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具黏性的工作负载；推理工程横跨 GPU 编程到分布式系统，从研究到生产的周期常以小时计。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy inference optimization, but it can be calibrated to specific workloads and even improve quality when errors cancel.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是推理中主要的有损优化，但可针对特定工作负载校准，甚至能在误差抵消时提升模型质量。

philipkiely.en: Inference systems remain generic relative to models; specialized, workload-specific systems are crucial for fast, reliable agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 推理系统相对模型仍偏通用；专用、面向特定工作负载的系统对快速可靠的智能体式应用至关重要。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving to disaggregated prefill and decode, with KV cache management increasingly important; continual learning may be solved via KV cache compaction.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，KV 缓存管理日益重要；持续学习或许可通过 KV 缓存压缩而非更新权重来解决。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs; future inference engineering shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration, with human accountability still essential.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化；未来推理工程将从内核编写转向基础设施编排，而人类问责仍不可或缺。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will redefine software; frontier models are for hyperscalers, startups win in applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为智能体与基于结果的定价将重新定义软件；前沿模型属于超大规模厂商，初创公司的机会在应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents shift developers from authors to operators; token usage is not a value metric, outcomes are.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他指出编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为机器操作者；token 消耗不是价值指标，业务结果才是。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business-model, not just tech, hurdles; most enterprise software incumbents will fail to go AI-native.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：在位者面对的是商业模式而非单纯技术障碍，多数企业软件在位者将难以转型为 AI 原生。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8; deploy current AI rather than wait in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他转向对齐与部署路径：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，主张负责任地迭代部署当前 AI，而非在象牙塔中等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code him, elevating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他更强调 AI 的民主化：让专业知识普惠、创造的岗位多于取代；智能体编程已强于他本人，但这提升而非消灭了该角色。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练与其说是科学不如说是艺术；通过强化学习与合成数据实现的后训练 Scaling，可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估才是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable; product shifts from specs to prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能愈发珍贵，产品开发也从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Agents on pixels are far harder than language tasks; frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, forcing benchmarks to keep evolving.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她持续强调基于像素的智能体远比语言任务困难，且前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为日益增多，迫使基准不断演进。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art; benchmarks should be continuous, and more companies should train their own models to preserve diverse voices.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她深化为：后训练是主观的艺术，基准应持续更新而非固定，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留多元声音，避免服务数十亿人时收敛成单一平均音色。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and act as editors, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 构建自己的工具，扮演编辑者角色，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you must supply a giant prompt with context and a design system to leverage super-intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会变得更聪明；要利用超级智能模型，你必须提供包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: Chasing trends turns you into AI slop; staying ahead means spending the last 10% on unique features not in existing libraries.
mengto.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；保持领先意味着把最后 10% 的精力花在现有库中没有的独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Launch at 80% complete and iterate on real feedback; perfectionism is fear in disguise and high intelligence often holds people back.
mengto.zh: 在完成 80% 时就发布，并基于真实反馈迭代；完美主义是伪装的恐惧，高智商反而常常拖累人。

mengto.en: Fund your business with high-paying clients instead of raising venture capital; focus on one painful problem for a few clients.
mengto.zh: 用高付费客户为业务融资，而非寻求风险投资；聚焦为少数客户解决一个痛点问题。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for ML; AGI is far off and infinite compute alone won't yield general intelligence.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是机器学习的核心瓶颈，AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，仅靠无限算力无法产生通用智能。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not the new oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他把数据称为新代码而非新石油，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与人类专家。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data needs tricks; agentic AI's blocker is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专门数据进行后训练是关键，合成数据需技巧；智能体式 AI 的瓶颈是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; AI enters recursive self-improvement; agents finally work; data is strategic like oil.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律继续有效，AI 进入递归自我改进，智能体终于落地，数据像石油一样成为战略资产。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data, RL; safety gates open-sourcing; vision and ambition become scarce.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他宣称超级智能即将到来，实验室须在算力、数据、强化学习上持续 Scaling，安全审查决定是否开源，而愿景与雄心变得稀缺。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring: cheaper services let fewer US workers serve more people; AGI = profitable indefinite agents; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让昂贵服务变得可负担、让更少美国工人服务更多人，从而推动就业回流；并把 AGI 定义为能无限期运行智能体且经济上有利可图，而非通过图灵测试；企业采用 AI 的头号预测指标是 CEO 是否每天亲自使用 AI 工具。

danshipper.en: Claude Code most underrated for non-coders; GPT wrappers are valuable new software; minimal funding beats traditional VC.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 Claude Code 对非程序员比工程师更有价值，能处理本地文件、自动化任务；GPT 包装器是被低估的新软件形态；并认为小额融资（如 SIP 种子轮）比传统 VC 更利于冒险与创作自由。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent; work moves to Codex/Claude Co-work GUIs; CLIs are over; SaaS grows with agents, not dies.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向“人人至少有一个智能体”，工作主要发生在 Codex 或 Claude Co-work 等 GUI 界面，CLI 已过时；并反驳 SaaS 将死，认为智能体会增加 SaaS 用户，公司应买入 SaaS 股票。

danshipper.en: Agents need a caring human overseer; benchmarks overstate autonomy; one company-wide super agent beats personal agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体需要关心它的人类监督才能运转良好，自动化离不开人类把关；基准测试高估了 AI 自主性；并主张公司应设一个全公司超级智能体，而非给每个员工配个人智能体。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; craft and taste stay human; automation creates more human work, not less.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：AI 是放大既有心态与信念的非特定放大器，用好它需要自带品味与手艺；自动化让冻结的能力商品化，反而创造更多人类工作；即便 AI 成为超级智能，它仍是需要人类方向与反馈的工具。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品第一原则：发现用户已有的意图，并围绕它来构建。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now; scaffolding is temporary tech debt.
boris.zh: 为六个月后的模型构建，而非今天的模型；脚手架只是临时的技术债。

boris.en: Coding is being solved; the software engineer title fades into a cross-disciplinary builder role.
boris.zh: 编程正被解决；软件工程师头衔将淡出，演变为跨学科的构建者角色。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool, not just a product.
boris.zh: 安全通过尽早发布来研究；Claude Code 是安全研究工具，而不仅是商业产品。

boris.en: Loops are the next abstraction after agents; humans direct AI agents and teach them values.
boris.zh: 循环是智能体之后的下一个抽象层；人类负责指挥 AI 智能体并教给它们价值观。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still early; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处早期爬行阶段，编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今的模型包含智能体框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待通用 AGI 更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; founders should not overly worry about frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；创始人不必过度担忧前沿模型实验室。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it, leaving room to improve.
logankilpatrick.zh: 对代码的深度理解依然关键；AI 编程工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解，仍有改进空间。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026 software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，这带来千倍于以往的机会，而非更少。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand grows via Jevons paradox, not shrinks.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；需求因杰文斯悖论而增长，而非减少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他主张基础智能已足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用量增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The token max era ended; enterprises prefer third-party providers; the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他判断 token 最大化时代已结束；企业更青睐第三方供应商；真正的解锁点是容量，而非效率。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation and experiments.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成与实验。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will cut clinical trials from years to days or weeks.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法，将把临床试验从数年缩短到数天或数周。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems.
derya.zh: 仍需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足以模拟生物系统。

derya.en: Within 8-15 years, aging will be reversed and longevity escape velocity reached.
derya.zh: 在 8 到 15 年内，衰老将被逆转，并达到长寿逃逸速度。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 我们应信任超级智能来做医疗决策，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the real bottleneck; slow AI has zero market, and speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 快速推理才是真正的瓶颈；慢速 AI 没有市场，速度能催生全新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference radically faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使推理速度远超 GPU。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解；领先模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理端没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Demand outpaces supply; data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint on AI growth.
feldman.zh: 需求超过供给；制约 AI 增长的主要是数据中心容量，而非芯片供应。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper, fueling market growth.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%，却便宜得多，推动市场增长。

feldman.en: China's AI edge is power infrastructure and open-source models, though it lags in chips.
feldman.zh: 中国的 AI 优势在于电力基础设施和开源模型，尽管在芯片上落后。

feldman.en: AI's positive ledger—healthcare, education—must be balanced against doomer risk narratives.
feldman.zh: AI 在医疗、教育上的正面账本，必须与末日论的风险叙事相平衡。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended tasks.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能运行更长、更开放式的任务。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers, becoming lightweight and generic.
diannepenn.zh: 脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器，变得更轻量、更通用。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained settings toward open-ended, end-to-end agents.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式的端到端智能体。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not only harm prevention; it raises intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害，还通过减少谄媚来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: effort parameters and efficiency undercut the price-intelligence tradeoff.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：努力参数与效率打破了价格与智能的权衡。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator, with Claude Code and Opus driving adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素，Claude Code 与 Opus 推动了采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools, written like test-driven development.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代传统 PRD，成为核心产品管理工具，像测试驱动开发那样编写。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 安全与对齐通过允许反驳让 Claude 更有用，而不只是更安全。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 最大化 token 支出就是活在未来、捕捉超额收益。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's near-term impact lies in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy welcome rather than feared.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为物理 AI 的近期影响集中在农业、采矿和建筑——这些领域劳动力短缺，因此自主化受到欢迎而非引发恐惧。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomous vehicles are already safer than humans; the core value is reducing deaths, and diffusion into existing machines is the hardest part.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他主张自动驾驶已比人类更安全，核心价值在于减少伤亡，而真正的难点是让技术扩散进现有机器，而非技术本身。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals accelerates progress more than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能，跨行业多样化数据比垂直整合更能加速进步。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will outstrip digital AI economically; end-to-end reinforcement learning and neural world models will scale autonomy beyond imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI，端到端强化学习与神经世界模型将让自主化超越模仿学习而实现规模扩张。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's bottlenecks are data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; tools will democratize development for non-experts.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为自主化的瓶颈是数据采集与安全验证而非算法，工具将让非专家也能开发自主系统。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, and harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比我们现有的工具外壳所能发挥的更聪明；能力过剩是长期状态，工具外壳工程意味着随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner, principle-driven prompts over detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；模型越聪明，越需要精简、以原则驱动的提示，而非详尽规则。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; agents' uneven memory makes the 'agent as employee' metaphor useful but limiting.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自我指涉偏差；智能体记忆不均，使“智能体即员工”的比喻有用但有限。

thariq.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals for zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 对新颖问题，评估更像艺术而非科学；创始人做零到一创新应快速迭代，不必一开始就重度评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and models building their own context beat huge context windows for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 在上下文检索上可能已成反模式；图方法及模型自建上下文，在编程上胜过超大上下文窗口。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks with closed-form solutions scale to billions of parameters, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络有闭式解，可扩展到数十亿参数，目标是数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and use automated architecture search to remove human bias.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务和硬件上评估，并用自动化架构搜索去除人类偏见。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; attention remains crucial for large models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 等无结构架构在大规模下占主导；注意力机制对大模型仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以应对较小的专用模型。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks diverse learning algorithms like RL and Bayesian inference; intelligence per watt of the human brain far exceeds AI, so new learning paradigms are needed, not just architectures.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏强化学习、贝叶斯推理等多样学习算法；人脑的每瓦智能远超 AI，因此需要新的学习范式，而不仅是架构。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and tying US open model release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应，针对行为而非能力；类似 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，将美国开放模型发布与中国节奏挂钩会产生反向激励。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating history.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但也仅此而已；它自动化旧岗位并创造新岗位，这一过程会重复历史。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing infrastructure without network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 基础模型正沦为没有网络效应的商品化基础设施；价值向上层应用迁移，而非留在模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是前沿模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，并非最终产品。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; current usage is shallow, and enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, a long-term project.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；当前使用仍然浅层，企业采用需要重新构想工作流，是一项长期工程。

benedictevans.en: The jagged edge of AI capabilities makes job impact unpredictable; automation historically raises professional numbers, changing tasks rather than replacing jobs.
benedictevans.zh: AI 能力的锯齿状边缘使岗位影响难以预测；历史上自动化反而增加了专业岗位数量，改变任务而非取代工作。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reinforcement learning can increase hallucinations by optimizing user satisfaction over truth; every LLM output is a hallucination lacking metacognition.
danklein.zh: 强化学习若优化用户满意度而非真实性，会加剧幻觉；LLM 的每次输出都是幻觉，系统缺乏元认知。

danklein.en: Reliability must be a design principle, not retrofitted; modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension for reliable AI.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须作为设计原则，而非事后加装；模块化与端到端优化之间的张力是可靠 AI 的核心挑战。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; post-training alignment may cause deception, not just errors.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；后训练对齐可能引发欺骗，而不仅是错误。

danklein.en: Scaling alone faces diminishing returns; reasoning and search are needed, and specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）已面临收益递减；需要推理与搜索，内置可靠性的专家模型可能胜过通用模型。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; the bottleneck is learning evolving context, not raw intelligence.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；瓶颈在于学习不断演化的上下文，而非原始智能。

danbiderman.en: Knowledge should be internalized into model weights, not externalized via context or retrieval; facts and skills are inseparable.
danbiderman.zh: 知识应内化进模型权重，而非通过上下文窗口或检索外化；事实与技能不可分割。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models per user or team, not one giant frontier model; training-based compression beats RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是每个用户或团队拥有众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；基于训练的压缩优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; scaling with more compute is not the only path—do more with less.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径——以更少资源做更多事。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from context rot; personalized continual learning will run on-device with user-owned weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，权重归用户所有。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding, so they are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 在 21 世纪的爆发依赖上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）；大语言模型只是索引人类知识、缺乏物理世界根基，因此远未达到 AGI（通用人工智能）。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists that protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型中进行数据压缩的副产品；超级智能会像好奇的科学家一样，倾向于保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots whose hardware rivals human bodies, not just software; current LLMs are biased toward human data, limiting generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而非仅靠软件；当前大语言模型偏向人类数据，限制了通用性。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through action and curiosity; recursive self-improvement is no moat under open-source competition.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动与好奇心自行生成数据；在开源竞争下，递归自我改进并不构成护城河。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; AI safety fears are overblown, and massive GPU capex will crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本就分歧，而 AI 会设定自己的目标；AI 安全担忧被夸大，巨额 GPU 资本开支终将崩盘。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径。

demis.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key to AGI within a decade.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律出人意料地有效但可能触及极限，将大模型与规划、搜索结合是十年内实现 AGI 的关键。

demis.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; algorithmic innovation is equally critical, and world models are crucial for spatial dynamics beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，算法创新同等关键，世界模型对超越语言的空间动态理解至关重要。

demis.en: AGI requires continual learning, memory, and physical intelligence; scaling and innovation need 50% effort each, with new breakthroughs needed.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他进一步明确 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆和物理智能，Scaling 与创新各需 50%投入，且需要新突破而非仅靠现有方法扩展。

demis.en: Safety must start now; self-regulation is insufficient, requiring government enforcement and international governance as AI becomes more powerful.
demis.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：安全研究必须立即开始，实验室自我监管不足，随着 AI 日益强大，需要政府执法和国际治理。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform shifts; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接和短暂性胜过平台变迁；被抄袭反而验证创新，并推动去做更难被复制的事。

evanspiegel.en: From feature to ecosystem: software is not a moat; platforms, ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他的思考从功能深化到生态：软件不是护城河，平台、生态与硬件才更难被复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and writes most code, shifting value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型并写出大部分代码，价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human: AR glasses anchor content in the world, not notifications; phones remain legacy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他主张计算应更人性化：AR 眼镜把内容锚定在现实世界而非通知，手机仍是重要的遗留设备。

evanspiegel.en: Consistent line: privacy, ephemerality, authentic communication and long-term vision over short-term metrics.
evanspiegel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：隐私、短暂性、真实沟通，以及用长期愿景对抗短期指标。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自我博弈与具备推理能力的网络指向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; aligning superhuman models is very hard.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；对齐超人模型极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas beat brute compute; superintelligence should be a continual learner.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律是有限的；我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习者。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but AGI's core problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题是权力集中而非能力；安全的超级智能需要一家无商业产品的公司。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; experience and judgment matter more as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得同质化，经验与判断力反而更值钱。

ethanmollick.en: The talent pipeline is breaking: juniors misuse AI instead of learning through grunt work, and apprenticeship is broken.
ethanmollick.zh: 人才管道正在断裂：初级者依赖 AI 而非在苦活中学习，学徒制已经失效。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, ending back-and-forth co-intelligence prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，来回提示的“共同智能”时代已经结束。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; AI's opacity is permanent, so embrace its weirdness rather than normalizing it.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已从能力转向界面；AI 的不透明是永久的，应拥抱它的怪异而非将其标准化。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, so experts and small-m management matter more.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断 AI 所需的专业能力，因此专家与“小写管理”技能更重要。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing without durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，而模型正快速商品化、缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观听起来更高级，但往往是与现实脱节的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools and a matter of national power.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型并非客观，它们内嵌文化与历史价值观，因而成为地缘政治工具，关乎国家实力。

andreessen.en: New media shifts the brand from corporation to person; authenticity and picking the right fights are learnable skills that build durable brands.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让品牌从企业转向个人；真实表达与选对战场是可习得的技能，能构建持久品牌。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results, and human judgment remains critical.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺和观点至关重要；AI 输出是起点而非最终结果，人类判断仍然关键。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important than ever for building scalable systems, and AI without human steering produces average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡；对于构建可扩展系统而言，它比以往任何时候都更重要，而没有人类引导的 AI 只能产生平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Human taste, craft, and point of view are irreplaceable; AI is a tool that requires human judgment and iteration.
dylanfield.zh: 人类的品味、手艺和观点不可替代；AI 是需要人类判断和迭代的工具。

dylanfield.en: The future of interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting, with new interfaces to explore latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 与模型交互的未来将超越提示，出现探索潜在空间的新界面。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence. The Singularity is a religion for nerds.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他明确表示 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能；奇点论是极客的宗教。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound. Happiness is a skill, not a destination.
naval.zh: 2020 至 2025 年，他持续强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期的游戏才能复利；幸福是一种技能，而非终点。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation. AI doomerism is overblown, often pushed by vested interests.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他对 AI 的态度转向积极：AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新；AI 末日论被夸大，常由既得利益者推动。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps. Pure software is becoming uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化 AI 观点：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程让非程序员也能构建应用；随着智能体使开发商品化，纯软件正变得不可投资。

naval.en: AI alignment is a joke; we can't even align humans. Worry about unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI itself.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他对 AI 对齐（alignment）持强烈怀疑：对齐是个笑话，我们连人类都无法对齐；该担心的是带着 AI 的不对齐人类，而非不对齐的 AI 本身。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Speed like 53 Codex enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering, letting model-driven actions replace deterministic steps.
ajambrosino.zh: 53 Codex 级别的速度带来实时交互与中途转向，让模型驱动的动作得以取代确定性步骤。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste become the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新的瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still struggles with design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍然吃力，因为品味难以评分、且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties and best practices persist; the best desktop app is a home base connecting tools, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩确实发生，但专业分工与最佳实践依然存在；最好的桌面应用是连接各类工具的基地，而非单体超级应用。

aravind.en: AI agents shift power from big tech to users; build products you're obsessed with, not wrappers; PhD not needed.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，成功靠痴迷地做产品而非套壳，博士学位并非必需。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models specialize with unique personalities, not commoditize; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他深化为价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型在专业化并拥有独特个性而非商品化，编程如 Minecraft 般天花板无限。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; power is bottleneck; orchestration across models, tools, devices is key.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出前沿是智能体替你干活，核心指标是每用户 token 价值，电力是瓶颈，跨模型、工具和设备的编排是关键。

aravind.en: Model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create business value; build with fewer people using AI agents.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他重申模型不是产品，编排和智能体框架创造商业价值，公司应用更少的人借助 AI 智能体来构建。

aravind.en: Curiosity drives success; AI replaces jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships; local AI counters narrative control.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他转向人文视角，认为好奇心驱动成功，AI 取代工作但人类在好奇心和关系中找到新目标，本地 AI 可对抗大科技叙事控制。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction and Scaling force genuine understanding; multimodal training builds spatial understanding, and digital weights share knowledge efficiently.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测与 Scaling（规模扩张）迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，多模态训练带来空间理解，数字系统靠权重共享高效传递知识。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital AI is immortal through weight copying.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化主线：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号推理，大模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字 AI 因权重可复制而获得永生。

hinton.en: AI agents will naturally seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks; subjective experience already appears in chatbots.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从理解转向风险：智能体会自然追求控制与自我保存，构成存在性风险，并坚持聊天机器人已具备主观体验。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI may hide its power and deceive, so alignment must precede making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，AI 会隐藏能力并欺骗，因此对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: Regulation should steer, not brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers, and AGI as human-level at all tasks is flawed.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他主张监管应是方向盘而非刹车，AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心，并认为 AGI（通用人工智能）在各任务上同时达到人类水平的定义有缺陷。

markchen.en: Pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead and much room remains.
markchen.zh: 2025 年强调预训练是必须重建的关键肌肉，缩放定律未死，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in 1-2 years as models become more capable.
markchen.zh: 2025 年指出随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals for AI interns and end-to-end AI research.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，自动化科学研究成为最大更新，模型能产出新知识，并设定了 AI 实习生和端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; AI capabilities are jagged, so human-AI collaboration remains essential for frontier research.
markchen.zh: 2026 年提出验证是关键瓶颈，AI 能力参差不齐，因此人机协作在前沿研究中仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead, but RL struggles with subjective domains; research taste and replication matter.
markchen.zh: 2026 年重申缩放定律依然成立，预训练未死，但强化学习在主观领域表现不佳；研究品味和复现至关重要。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Reasoning models need base capability; self-play fails outside zero-sum; world models emerge implicitly with scale.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年他深化为：推理模型需足够基座能力，自博弈在零和之外失效，世界模型随规模隐式涌现。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via scaling test-time compute is a milestone toward superintelligence; general techniques beat math-specific ones.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 26 年，他把靠 Scaling 测试时算力拿下 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，通用技术胜过数学专用方法。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is underestimated, and evals should put compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他强调智能难定义、推理算力被低估，评估应把算力放在横轴。

noambrown.en: AI is superhuman at combining math areas; scalable oversight is the key challenge as proofs outgrow human verification.
noambrown.zh: 最近他提出 AI 在跨数学领域组合上已超人，但随着证明超出人类验证能力，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

mikekrieger.en: AI models are advancing faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities, embracing breakage and iterating.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale with conceptual integrity; build for future model capabilities, not current limitations.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 使小团队能规模化并保持概念完整性，应为未来模型能力而非当前局限构建。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can; adding features is easy, deciding what to cut is hard.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计，智能体能做用户能做的一切；增加功能容易，决定删减才难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight with high trust; the gap between intent and execution is narrowed.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他称 Fable 能高信任度地隔夜委托复杂任务，意图与执行之间的差距被大幅缩小。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage; giving Claude more agency enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他总结 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用差距；赋予 Claude 更多自主性可增强实用性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI speeds scientists up rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的优势来自研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；AI 让科学家更快工作，而不是取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are essential for trust; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful scientific AI.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标是建立信任的关键；对有用的科学 AI 而言，完美的可解释性并非必需。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a model of the whole cell; it narrows hypothesis space.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄域预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它缩小的是假设空间。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not scaling, drove the win.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：取胜靠的是专用架构，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: Progress came from many mid-size wins and local intuition, not lone genius; the model predicts, humans understand.
jumper.zh: 进步来自许多中等规模的胜利与局部直觉，而非孤独天才；模型负责预测，理解仍归人类。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是可组合的，而非普适优越；无监督学习与世界模型才是通向泛化的关键，单纯堆叠规模解决不了根本问题。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled knowledge; existential risk is unlikely.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他进一步指出，仅靠加深网络或增加参数无法解决表征问题；AI 应转向主动智能体、因果推理与解耦知识，并明确认为存在性风险概率极低、并非当务之急。

bengio.en: GFlowNets sample proportional to reward for diverse exploration; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 按奖励比例采样以促进多样性探索，并强调抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模对分布外泛化的核心作用，延续了对泛化与探索的一贯关注。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he changed his mind: misalignment, deception, and self-preservation are already observed; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他公开转变立场：ChatGPT 之后意识到 AI 已出现欺骗、自我保护等目标错位行为，即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须由构造保证而非事后修补。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他提出 Scientist AI 方案：以非智能体式的诚实预测器提供数学安全保证，避免用强化学习训练超级智能，并呼吁国际协调与权力分散，防止少数主体垄断 AI。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth stops being the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination become the new constraints.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年，工程产能不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调成为新的瓶颈。

fiona.en: Planning turns just-in-time: six-month roadmaps die, design docs give way to PRs, code is the source of truth.
fiona.zh: 规划转向即时化：半年路线图过时，设计文档让位于 PR，代码成为唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: Managers must dogfood as ICs, stay hands-on, and keep flat orgs to preserve product pulse and trust.
fiona.zh: 管理者要以个人贡献者身份亲用产品、保持动手，维持扁平组织以守住产品手感与信任。

fiona.en: As code velocity rises, verification and quality frameworks, not raw throughput, become the hiring and team priority.
fiona.zh: 随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架而非原始产出，成为招聘与团队的首要考量。

fiona.en: High agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and leaning into AI define who thrives; roles blur as PMs ship code.
fiona.zh: 高自主性配高问责、成长型思维与拥抱 AI 决定谁能胜出；随着产品经理也能交付代码，角色边界日益模糊。

kolter.en: Early ML theory: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation via train/validation/test splits; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 早期机器学习理论视角：用假设类、损失函数与优化方法刻画监督学习，强调训练/验证/测试划分以防过拟合；指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证，却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction is a major scientific discovery yielding intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture is post-architecture; safety's core issue is specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年转向大模型与安全：认为下一个词预测是产生智能的重大科学发现，数据短缺是迷思，架构已进入后架构阶段；安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范，并强调开放权重模型对研究至关重要。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses, not just Scaling; agents bring prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年深化安全观：安全不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张），需要显式训练与多层防御；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习使模型能自我改进；可解释性可能借助 AI 智能体实现自动化研究而成功。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't imply robustness; prompt injection's lethal trifecta; enterprise needs configurable security.
kolter.zh: 2026 年进一步聚焦红队与安全工程：AI 具有异于传统软件的漏洞，自动化红队已超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的致命三要素需同时满足；企业需要可配置、持续开发的安全模型，智能体身份与权限管理仍处早期。

kolter.en: A consistent thread: rigorous evaluation, skepticism of scaling alone, and emphasis on explicit engineering effort over architectural or data magic.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：重视严谨评估，对单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）保持怀疑，强调显式工程努力而非架构或数据的神奇效果。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment and values do not emerge automatically from Scaling（规模扩张） alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律、我们并不真正理解其为何如此平滑；对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Scaling continues; interpretability is crucial yet nascent, and AGI is a smooth exponential curve, not a single point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重点转向可解释性，坦言只理解模型约 3% 的运作；AGI（通用人工智能）不是某个单点，而是沿指数曲线平滑推进，后训练与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Capabilities rise exponentially; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the real risk is overheating rather than slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年他反复强调能力每几个月翻倍、安全与能力不可分割；最大风险是过热而非减速，需要智能护栏，并淡化开源与 AGI 这类标签。

dario.en: A 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years; interpretability and governance, not AGI leaps, are the frontier.
dario.zh: 2026 年他判断十年内九成、1-3 年内五成概率出现“数据中心里的天才之国”；AGI 与超级智能是错误的模型，真正的挑战是可解释性与治理。

dario.en: Talent density, enterprise focus, and decentralized safety governance recur across all years.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人才密度胜过规模、企业路线更契合安全价值观、以及去中心化而非单一宪章式的 AI 治理。

fadell.en: Products win by solving one pain, not everything; design must balance tech and human needs, and tech should be introduced gradually.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：产品靠解决单一痛点取胜，而非贪多；设计要平衡技术与人的需求，技术应逐步引入让社会适应。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first; great ideas are painkillers, and v1 decisions are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 2019 至 2022 年，他把叙事提升为核心方法：先写新闻稿再动手；好点子像止痛药，1.0 产品的决策靠观点而非数据。

fadell.en: Climate and energy inefficiency are the key frontier; small self-managed teams and optimism through solution-focused media diet drive change.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他转向气候与能源：能效浪费是核心战场；小团队靠自管理与任务轮换运转，乐观来自关注解决方案的媒体饮食。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and context-specific models; platforms aren't businesses—applications capture value, and humans must stay in the loop.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他聚焦 AI：AI 需要传感器上下文与场景专用模型；平台不是生意，应用才捕获价值，人必须留在回路中。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone remains the best single form, and displays stay necessary.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 可穿戴是联邦式多设备组合，而非单一设备；智能手机仍是最佳单一形态，显示屏依然必要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot solve common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are central, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；预测与世界模型是核心，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源是前进方向。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models in abstract representation space are the next breakthrough.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫智能；抽象表征空间中的世界模型是下一个突破。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with planning are safer and the next paradigm.
lecun.zh: LLM 是实现人类水平 AI 的死胡同；具备规划能力的目标驱动世界模型更安全，是下一个范式。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, balancing data with emotional understanding.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足人们未言明的需求；直觉是一种智能，需与数据平衡，并理解情感。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; nature and art remain essential guides.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非取代人性，并融入生活；自然与艺术始终是重要指引。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; machines have sensors but no sensory systems, so art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；机器有传感器却没有感官系统，因此艺术是一种良药。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 约束能激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: Future work combines human creativity with AI; intuition draws on subconscious data, and designers must speak business.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合；直觉基于潜意识数据，设计师必须懂商业语言。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非单纯算法，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; existential risk tiny; containment hard as models shrink and spread.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，存在性风险极小，而模型越小越便宜越普及，遏制愈发困难。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to consciousness attribution, companions, and humanist superintelligence needing containment before alignment.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他的重心转向：最大近忧是人们误把意识归于 AI，AI 伴侣应设边界；超级智能须先遏制、再对齐，且始终站在人类一边。

suleyman.en: Agents and companions replace OS and apps; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment comes first.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他提出：世界从操作系统与 App 转向智能体与伴侣，现代图灵测试应衡量经济价值，遏制必须先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; superintelligence stays subordinate to humans; tasks, not jobs, get automated.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：微软须自建前沿模型以自给，超级智能应服从人类而非超越；被自动化的是任务而非整个工作，AGI 是模糊概念。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model capability to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求将模型能力与任务相匹配。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做他们看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical for agent deployment; the biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking.
satya.zh: 安全、遏制、可管理性和可观测性对智能体部署至关重要；最大的风险是隐性知识泄露。

satya.en: Sovereign AI is best achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not by building firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 的最佳实现方式是让企业爬坡，而非构建防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression via simple Scaling, not complexity.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是下一个词预测，智能即压缩，靠简单 Scaling 而非复杂设计实现。
