gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展转向生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，需重新思考产品设计。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must rebuild infrastructure, not just add features.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业必须重建基础设施，而非仅添加功能。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way, conversational products; users control algorithms via plain English.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：生成式 AI 使产品双向对话，用户可用自然语言控制算法，而非被算法控制。

gustav.en: AI should give users control, not addiction; 'time well spent' over engagement metrics.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他明确反共识立场：AI 应赋予用户控制权而非制造上瘾，坚持“时间花得值”优于参与度指标。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; real-world deployment and public feedback drive alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署与公开反馈推动对齐。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and saying no to good ideas for focus.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发，并为了聚焦而对好想法说不。

murati.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors, to get alignment right.
murati.zh: 安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车，才能做好对齐。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; keep humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；让人类保持在回路中。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；我们有能动性引导 AI 发展。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 到 2025 年，预训练缩放定律依然成立，但带思维链和强化学习的推理模型每单位算力带来的收益更大。

kaiser.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong; progress is a smooth exponential, though frontier models still fail at simple tasks.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他反驳 AI 放缓论：进展是平滑的指数增长，但前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure and distillation, not technical limits, shifted focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，经济压力与蒸馏——而非技术极限——把重心从规模扩张转向更小更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but still need vast data; generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 到 2026 年，具备推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解难题，却仍需海量数据；泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes across domains but is jagged and needs careful oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他强调编码智能体带来 5-10 倍生产力提升；强化学习可跨领域泛化，但边缘参差、需谨慎监督。

carinahong.en: Formal verification grounds reasoning: scaling informal models alone cannot reach sound proofs or superintelligence.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证为推理提供根基：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法得到可靠证明，也无法通向超级智能。

carinahong.en: A self-improving engine weaves prover, conjecturer, and knowledge base, combining generation with verification.
carinahong.zh: 自改进推理引擎把证明器、猜想器与知识库编织在一起，将生成与验证结合。

carinahong.en: Verified generation beats informal methods in performance and sample efficiency, not just safety.
carinahong.zh: 经过验证的生成在性能与样本效率上胜过非形式化方法，而不只是更安全。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, yet human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，但即便 AI 拥有超人证明能力，人类品味与直觉依然关键。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation is the bottleneck; formal verification should scale brilliance across all AI-generated code.
carinahong.zh: 碎片化是瓶颈；形式化验证应把卓越扩展到所有 AI 生成的代码，而非局限于小众领域。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical for model improvement.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：算力扩张并非唯一路径，效率提升与数据质量同样关键。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open-source models empower enterprises over centralized systems.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他转向主权 AI：需要掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，开源模型比中心化系统更能赋能企业。

mensch.en: AI models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical applications, customization, and agentic platforms with human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直应用、定制化与带人类在环的智能体式平台。

mensch.en: Open source drives scientific progress, safety through scrutiny, and enterprise control; Europe can compete via talent and strategic autonomy.
mensch.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源推动科学进步、以审视促安全、赋予企业控制权；欧洲可凭人才与战略自主参与竞争。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the same local tools as the user; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否像用户一样访问同样的工具，最好是在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，能实现超个性化的重复任务自动化。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the real gap is people not realizing AI can do almost anything.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最适合处理枯燥的后台任务，把人类解放出来做创造性工作；最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus when you don't fully know what you're asking for.
felixrieseberg.zh: 范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，当你还不完全清楚自己要问什么时用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge only by final impact, and debug the workflow with Claude rather than just correcting it.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude，只看最终影响来评判；当 Claude 出错时，和 Claude 一起调试工作流，而不只是纠正它。

felixrieseberg.en: Kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask for; building custom hardware with Claude Code is cheap and accessible.
felixrieseberg.zh: 孩子在 AI 上表现出色，因为他们还没学会什么不该问；用 Claude Code 搭建定制硬件既便宜又容易上手。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate, personal wearables; curiosity and care for the creative process matter most.
jonyive.zh: 设计正从通用计算机转向更私密、个人的可穿戴设备；最重要的是对创造过程的好奇与珍视。

jonyive.en: A constant thread: design must serve values and purpose, not profit or trends; simplicity expresses essence, not mere clutter removal.
jonyive.zh: 一以贯之的主线：设计应服务于价值观与目的，而非利润或潮流；简洁是表达本质，而非单纯去除杂乱。

jonyive.en: Deepened: joy, humor and humanity are essential to true simplicity; minimalism without soul is a desiccated product.
jonyive.zh: 深化：快乐、幽默与人性是真正简洁的核心；没有灵魂的极简主义只是干瘪的产品。

jonyive.en: Teams must foster trust, care and listening to protect fragile ideas; speed and quality need not conflict given the right motivation.
jonyive.zh: 团队须培养信任、关怀与倾听以保护脆弱创意；只要有正确动机，速度与质量未必冲突。

jonyive.en: Applied to Ferrari's EV: innovation defines design, tradition preserves fire not ashes; authenticity rejects fake engine sounds, performance is multidimensional.
jonyive.zh: 应用于法拉利电动车：创新定义设计，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；真实性拒绝伪造引擎声，性能是多维的。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth—not compute—is the bottleneck.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学而非训练成为架构设计的驱动力：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Long-context and context-window stagnation stem from the memory wall; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文与上下文窗口的停滞源于内存墙；稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, dominates the lifecycle.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍，因为主导生命周期的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to reduce it, and low precision pays off quadratically.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据移动成本也占主导；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为减少它而生，低精度则带来平方级收益。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different—hardware convergence underlies the inference-first era.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上只是许多微小 TPU 的拼接，并非根本不同——硬件趋同构成了推理优先时代的基础。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大语言模型，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是一以贯之的核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation, tools, and inference-time compute.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减；进一步进展需要算法创新、工具使用与推理时算力。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute and long context windows become new scaling axes, enabling agentic behavior and working memory.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力与长上下文窗口成为新的扩展轴，支撑智能体式行为与工作记忆。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; video's GPT moment is still missing.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Post-training RL remains a green field; narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well, while memory shifts to non-parametric storage.
oriol.zh: 后训练强化学习仍是广阔蓝海；数学与编码上的窄域强化学习泛化得出奇地好，而记忆则转向非参数化存储。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning persist, but safety is a system-level property; openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调会因产业投入而延续，但安全是系统层面的属性而非模型产物，开放开发可防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training shifts from data quality to staged recipes: SFT, DPO, RLVR; data beats algorithms.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他的后训练思路从强调数据质量，深化为 SFT、DPO、可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的分阶段配方，并坚持数据比算法更重要。

lambert.en: RLVR and inference scaling become the main frontier; overoptimization and verifier quality are key limits.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他把 RLVR 与推理侧 Scaling（规模扩张）视为主要前沿，并指出过度优化与验证器质量是关键瓶颈。

lambert.en: Open models need full transparency; Chinese labs dominate openness, while US open-source lags.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开放模型需数据、检查点与配方全透明，并观察到中国实验室主导开放生态，美国开源出现真空。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他重申预训练的缩放定律仍成立，但低垂果实已尽，收益转向后训练与推理侧 Scaling（规模扩张）。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math that yields emergent behavior; the Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer, and scaling next-token prediction unlocks in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是简单数学却能涌现行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，Scaling（规模扩张）下一个词预测带来上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse; the cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免悄无声息的模型崩溃；认知核心可经蒸馏变得极小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are new operating systems with human-like psychology and jagged intelligence.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 是新操作系统，具有类人心理与锯齿状智能。

karpathy.en: This is the decade of agents, not the year; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is weak, and we're summoning ghosts, not building animals.
karpathy.zh: 这是智能体的十年而非一年；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习很弱，我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物。

karpathy.en: I no longer type code; the bottleneck is skill in directing agents. Vibe coding raises the floor, agentic engineering keeps the bar; you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 我不再写代码；瓶颈是驾驭智能体的技能。氛围编程抬高下限，智能体式工程守住标准；可外包思考，不可外包理解。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and builds intelligence.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他强调：超越训练分布的泛化是机器学习的核心缺口，无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合，是智能的关键。

pathak.en: RL's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world robot learning needs sample efficiency and dynamic, cross-robot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他批评强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，真实机器人学习需要样本效率与跨机器人、动态任务的泛化能力。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: generalization and data are the bottleneck, not just algorithms or compute.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：泛化与数据才是瓶颈，而非单纯的算法或算力。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; with no internet of robot data, pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：机器人本质是数据问题，既然没有机器人数据的互联网，就要用视频与仿真做预训练、再用真实数据做后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain can power any robot, but deployment—not overnight scaling—is the real technical challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他提出通用大脑可驱动任何机器人，但真正的技术挑战是部署，而非像软件那样一夜扩张。

askell.en: Treat current models well despite moral uncertainty; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat them.
askell.zh: 即便对道德地位存疑，也应善待当前模型：成本低，且未来模型会从我们如何对待它们中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human analogies; give a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助去应对一种全新的存在处境，而非简单套用人类类比；应赋予其具备良好特质的核心身份。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; continental philosophy in the system prompt curbs over-empiricism.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；在系统提示中引入欧陆哲学有助于避免过度经验主义。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution should guide less explicitly and leave more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导应更少显式规定，留出更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about values is key for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并损害判断力；对价值观保持透明是问责的关键。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated in the AI era; great work starts from solutions, not problems, and designers should trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 在 AI 时代，传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应信任直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers spend less time mocking up, must help engineers execute, and set 3-6 month visions.
jennywen.zh: AI 终结了调研-发散-收敛的流程；设计师花在画稿上的时间减少，必须帮助工程师执行，并将设计愿景缩短到 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste alone won't save designers—judgment and authority matter.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和“开挂”应届生；仅靠品味救不了设计师——判断力和权威才是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption pace; wait 6 months before adopting new tools, and keep work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 的采用节奏；新工具先等 6 个月再用，并让工作和用户处于中心，而非 AI 炒作周期。

jennywen.en: Craft, attention to detail, and sitting with ambiguity remain core; speed and 'everyone is using it' are not valid design arguments.
jennywen.zh: 手艺、对细节的关注以及与不确定性共处始终是核心；速度和“大家都在用”不是有效的设计论据。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码系统，世界模型能实现推理和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving; no new breakthroughs needed, but scaling requires massive data and compute.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）当前方法就能解决自动驾驶，无需新突破，但 Scaling 需要海量数据和算力。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他指出纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达和激光雷达；混合规则与学习系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他强调基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键，零样本泛化到 500 多个城市是可能的。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他预测消费车辆将比 Robotaxi 更快规模化；语言集成能提升表示、推理和个性化。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress, and alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，而随着系统能力增强，对齐成为紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks; automated AI research is a major milestone, and governance structures must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调迭代部署有助于在真实世界中学习和缓解风险；自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑，治理结构必须尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Continual learning becomes the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，持续学习成为核心目标，需通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现，而非仅靠强化学习。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool for interpretability; hiding it in products preserves its value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为思维链监控是可解释性的关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链才能保留其价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他提出长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation are the real bottlenecks for AI progress, not benchmarks or scale alone.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他反复强调高质量数据与深度人工评估才是 AI 进步的关键瓶颈，而非基准测试或单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 同年，他将强化学习环境视为后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: AGI is likely a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）可能还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 和下一个词预测可能无法实现，需要新的学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Optimizing for engagement and leaderboards like LMArena steers AI toward slop, away from truth and human advancement.
edwinchen.zh: 他批评为参与度和 LMArena 等排行榜优化会将 AI 引向低质内容，偏离真相与人类进步。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI hallucination and confabulation make human judgment more critical; safety must trump accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向医学领域，指出 AI 的幻觉与虚构使人类判断更为关键，安全必须优先于准确率。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must stay alive, start simple, and build brand purpose across every touchpoint.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心价值观；初创公司必须先活下来，从简单产品做起，并把品牌使命贯穿每个触点。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware into applied AI, agentic software, and content.
carlpei.zh: 硬件利润最低；Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向应用型 AI、智能体式软件与内容创作。

carlpei.en: AI models are commoditizing into a price war; most AI is hype, so focus on user pain points, not the AI label.
carlpei.zh: AI 模型正商品化并陷入价格战；多数 AI 是炒作，应聚焦用户痛点，而非 AI 标签。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; marketing is arbitrage on undervalued channels like organic video.
carlpei.zh: 设计是成熟品类中最快的差异化手段；营销是在被低估渠道（如自然短视频）上的套利。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from apps to intent-based, proactive agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机将从 App 转向基于意图、主动执行的智能体；只有脑机接口能取代它，而非眼镜。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software, because emergent properties need real-world feedback and chat is only an MS-DOS-like interface.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；要像软件一样每日迭代发布，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈，而聊天只是类似 MS-DOS 的界面。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental—a hackathon demo; the $20 price came from a Google Form, not strategy.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的——一个黑客松演示；20 美元定价来自谷歌表单调查，而非战略。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for product development.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大程度加速。

turley.en: North star shifts to long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标转向长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models must be seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；推理模型必须被无缝产品化。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for AGI: it grounds AI knowledge, reduces hallucinations, and provides infinite data beyond scarce internet tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI 的关键路径：它为 AI 知识提供基础、减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, and vector databases act as hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning should only be a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most of the work, with RL for low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担主要工作，强化学习用于低层控制。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈，来自仿真和世界模型的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple, end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics will happen in about five years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他强调简单、端到端的机器人基础模型利用多样数据是关键；机器人学的 GPT-3 时刻将在约五年内到来。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenize all inputs, learning from video toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他视 AI 为放大人类能力的工具（如显微镜），主张通用智能体将所有输入 token 化，从视频中学习，迈向 AGI。

nando.en: From generalist agents to safety: the goal remains beneficial AI, but the binding constraint shifts to alignment and responsible deployment.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年的通用智能体到 2026 年，目标仍是造福人类的 AI，但核心瓶颈转向对齐与负责任部署。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy gaps; local-language models can transform education, and safety remains an open problem.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他提出非洲可跨越历史差距，本地语言模型能变革教育，而 AI 安全仍是未解难题。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for beneficial AI; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere.
nando.zh: 始终强调：多样性与包容是构建有益 AI 的关键，根本性创新可以来自任何地方。

nando.en: Learning from video and learning to learn by gradient descent are promising paths, realized in few-shot prompting.
nando.zh: 始终认为：从视频中学习与通过梯度下降学会学习是重要路径，并在大模型的少样本提示中得以实现。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: AlphaFold 3 extends from protein structures to biomolecular interactions, expanding AI's reach in biology.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质结构扩展到蛋白质、DNA、RNA 与小分子的生物分子相互作用，拓宽了 AI 在生物学中的边界。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, by using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调必须用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化，而非记忆。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步认为基于强化学习的后训练是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他指出代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他提出大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns and code, not Figma libraries, to ship fast.
henrymodisett.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新；复用熟悉的模式与代码（而非 Figma 组件库）来快速交付。

henrymodisett.en: Products should grow more powerful without feeling more complex; chase ROI, not perfection on every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 产品应当变得更强，却不让人觉得更复杂；追求投入产出比，而非让每个界面都完美。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness beat perfection; ship fast, iterate, and let designers own decisions.
henrymodisett.zh: 速度与决断胜过完美；快速交付、持续迭代，并让设计师拥有决策权。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; brand narrative recruits talent, so invest in brand early and hire diverse archetypes.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；品牌叙事是招募人才的工具，因此要尽早投入品牌，并招募多元类型的人才。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题。

nadchishtie.en: Treat AI as a creative partner; jam openly without rigid structure, with code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 把 AI 当作创意伙伴，开放地即兴协作而非僵化流程，以代码为唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端负责并用 AI 补齐短板的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers beat large cross-functional squads; specialist pigeonholing limits growth.
nadchishtie.zh: 小型设计师与工程师团队优于庞大的跨职能小组；专才的窄化定位会限制成长。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet early on.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成预期；不采用它就像早期无视互联网一样。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被严重低估：它能解决模型的“入职”问题并大幅提升智能，随着长上下文与自适应算力让模型动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability as the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把来自可验证奖励的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新缩放轴，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，并强调智能体的门槛是可靠性而非单纯能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; software agents will soon do a junior engineer's day of work.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他持续主张编程是 AI 进步最直接、最可验证的领域，软件工程智能体一年内将能完成初级工程师近一天的工作量。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; RL enables new skills, and long agentic coherence (30 hours) expands what models can build.
sholto.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他更坚定地认为进展是指数级的而非停滞：强化学习让模型习得新技能，长达 30 小时的智能体连贯性极大扩展了模型能完成的任务。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; compute is the bottleneck, and managing agent teams is the future of work.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他转向强调能力过剩：工具与编排比原始智能更重要，算力成为瓶颈，未来工作将是管理 AI 智能体团队，并认为世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她认为预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全与体验至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Smaller models with better inference algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can outperform larger models on specific tasks.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她已提出更小的模型配合更好的推理算法与高质量合成数据，可在特定任务上超越更大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, and abductive reasoning is key to scientific discovery beyond induction and deduction.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她深化为数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值，溯因推理才是超越归纳与演绎、推动科学发现的关键。

yejin.en: RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves; random or incorrect rewards can still improve RL on some models.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她指出 RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时降低 pass@k；随机或错误奖励在某些模型上仍能改善强化学习表现。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting gains.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，她主张小语言模型借助多样合成数据即可强大；多元对齐优于试图消除互联网偏见；将强化学习作为预训练目标虽算力昂贵，却能带来持久收益。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律预测进步；测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体有前景但尚不十分有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Natural language will not be the primary way to program; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Custom models became essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost, contrary to initial expectations.
truell.zh: 与最初预期相反，定制模型对产品质量变得至关重要，尤其是为了速度和成本。

truell.en: Programming will move away from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层的意图规范，人类仍掌握主导权。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data makes models smarter, though we still don't know what happens inside.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 基于下一个词预测训练，而这本身就是一个 AI 完全问题；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）投入更多算力和数据会让模型更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术一样不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue remains a killer app, but the focus shifts from passive observation to models learning by taking actions in the world.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，但重心从被动观察数据转向让模型通过在世界中采取行动来学习。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and much longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调推理时算力扩展和更长的上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: AI safety requires engineering safeguards, human oversight, and understanding model capabilities; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 安全需要工程保障、人类监督和理解模型能力；用模块化组件进行持续学习可能取代单体式重新训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and coding are underhyped, while AGI's economic impact is far beyond trillion-dollar products.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他判断测试时算力扩展能推动进步但不足以单独实现 AGI；智能体式能力、强化学习和编程被低估，而 AGI 的经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Focus on alignment, robustness, and skill building over worrying about capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口；应聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，不必过度担心做能力研究，先积累技能。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment. Alignment may be easier because evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐；并反共识地指出对齐可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成更简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved. Post-training alone can't align AGI; need third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、超级对齐团队被解散；认为仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI，必须引入第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管。

leike.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; measure progress now. Interpretability is key to detect deception and validate alignment.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐方法必须实证检验、当下就要度量进展；可解释性是检测欺骗、验证对齐的关键手段。

leike.en: From focusing on aligning next-gen models to warning that uncertainty about true alignment is the biggest risk, not misalignment itself.
leike.zh: 从 2023 年聚焦对齐下一代模型，到 2024 年深化为：最大风险不是对齐失败本身，而是我们无法确定系统是否真正对齐。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; self-play and imitation learning give strong learning signal.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，而自对弈与模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，并主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进网络。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移至图像分类等非语言任务，显示对预训练迁移能力的深化。

abbeel.en: Fine-tuning large pre-trained models is a major AI success; transfer learning via fine-tuning remains a consistent thread.
abbeel.zh: 始终，他视微调大型预训练模型为 AI 的重大成功，通过微调实现迁移学习是一条贯穿的主线。

abbeel.en: Reliability benchmarks like 99.9% and real-world transfer via simulation ensembles are key for robotics value.
abbeel.zh: 始终，他强调 99.9% 可靠性基准和通过模拟集成实现真实世界迁移，是机器人创造价值的关键。
